# ScalePad Documentation

> Documentation for ScalePad

## Guides
- [Getting started with the ScalePad API](https://developer.scalepad.com/docs/getting-started.md)
- [API versioning policy](https://developer.scalepad.com/docs/api-versioning-policy.md)
- [List Clients](https://developer.scalepad.com/reference/list-clients-1.md): This endpoint retrieves a detailed list of clients.
- [Get Client](https://developer.scalepad.com/reference/get-client-1.md): This endpoint retrieves a single client, identified by its unique ID.
- [List Assessments](https://developer.scalepad.com/reference/apipublicv1assessmentslist.md): Retrieve a comprehensive list of all assessments.
- [Create Agreement](https://developer.scalepad.com/reference/apipublicv1agreementscreate.md): Create an agreement with full details.
- [Ingest Backup Results](https://developer.scalepad.com/reference/backupradar-ingest.md): Ingest backup results for a device.
